verdicts.reason: A stacks the original's portrait text column into the left half, which leaves the right ~40% of the banner dead. The headline is undersized for the format, the gap between headline and body is uneven, and the circle nearly touches the top and bottom edges. B spreads into a real left-to-right banner (product, then a large headline and body, then badges and CTA), so the hierarchy is stronger. Its flaws: the GLACIER wordmark floats centred over the gutter instead of aligning with the headline column, the body copy sits jammed near the bottom edge, and the circle also crowds the canvas edges.
